# naapurustot.fi

> naapurustot.fi is a free, independent map service for comparing and exploring neighbourhoods across Finland. It presents 50+ official open-data indicators — income, employment, education, housing, services, safety, transit and environment — for 3,018 postal-code areas spanning all 69 Finnish sub-regions (seutukunnat). "Naapurustot" is Finnish for "neighbourhoods".

naapurustot.fi is a static, browser-based application: no account required, no paywall, no advertising, no cookies or cross-site tracking. Every value shown traces to a verifiable public data source — the project never uses synthetic, estimated or placeholder data. Content is available in Finnish (default), English and Swedish. The service is independent and not affiliated with any government agency, real-estate company or data provider.

## Primary pages

- [Interactive map (home)](https://naapurustot.fi/): Choropleth map of every neighbourhood; pick any of 50+ data layers and click an area for full statistics, rankings and side-by-side comparison.
- [All areas — directory](https://naapurustot.fi/kaupungit/): Index of all 69 Finnish sub-regions, each linking to a regional overview page.
- [Sitemap](https://naapurustot.fi/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of every neighbourhood and region page in all three languages.

## Per-neighbourhood profile pages

Every postal-code area has a static, pre-rendered profile page listing its statistics, in three languages:

- Finnish: `https://naapurustot.fi/alue/{postalcode}-{name}`
- English: `https://naapurustot.fi/en/area/{postalcode}-{name}`
- Swedish: `https://naapurustot.fi/sv/omrade/{postalcode}-{name}`

Example: [00100 Helsinki Keskusta](https://naapurustot.fi/alue/00100-helsinki-keskusta-etu-toolo)

## Regional overview pages

Each of the 69 sub-regions has an overview page that lists all of its neighbourhoods with key statistics:

- Finnish: `https://naapurustot.fi/kaupunki/{region}/`
- English: `https://naapurustot.fi/en/city/{region}/`
- Swedish: `https://naapurustot.fi/sv/stad/{region}/`

## Data & methodology

- [Full data, coverage & methodology reference](https://naapurustot.fi/llms-full.txt): Complete catalogue of every data layer with definitions, the regional coverage table, the Quality Index methodology, sources and licensing.
- [Open data — bulk download & API](https://naapurustot.fi/avoin-data/): The full dataset as CSV (all postal-code areas × ~60 metrics, plus a long-format time series and a codebook with per-column provenance and licensing), and a frozen static JSON API at `https://naapurustot.fi/api/v1/areas/{postal_code}.json`, `https://naapurustot.fi/api/v1/areas.json` and `https://naapurustot.fi/api/v1/metrics.json`.

Primary data sources: Tilastokeskus, Väylävirasto, HSY, Poliisi, OpenStreetMap, LIPAS (Jyväskylän yliopisto), Traficom, Helsingin yliopisto, Digital Geography Lab, Ylioppilastutkintolautakunta, NASA Black Marble (VIIRS), Helsinki Region Infoshare, naapurustot.fi (koostettu), Säteilyturvakeskus (STUK), Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitos (THL), Suomen ympäristökeskus (SYKE). Statistics Finland data is licensed CC BY 4.0; OpenStreetMap data under the ODbL.

## Kaavat ja hankkeet (planning & infrastructure)

naapurustot.fi also publishes a planning corpus — land-use plans (asemakaavat)
and infrastructure projects (rata- ja tiehankkeet) — alongside the statistical
layers. It currently covers 1860 entries across 841 postal-code
areas: 1338 infrastructure projects and 522 detailed plans.

- **Infrastructure projects** are nationwide, sourced from Väylävirasto (the
  Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency): rail and road projects with status
  and schedule.
- **Detailed plans (asemakaavat)** currently cover Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Tampere, Turku, Vantaa,
  sourced from each municipality's open zoning WFS. Plan geometry is real, not a
  proxy.

National zoning coverage is incomplete because Finland has no single national
zoning register yet; it is expected once the Ryhti built-environment information
system (SYKE) reaches national coverage around 2029. Until then, plans are added
city by city as open WFS endpoints become available.

This corpus is downloadable as `naapurustot.fi/avoin-data/naapurustot_kaavat_hankkeet.csv`
(long format: pno, region, type, status, name, date, source URL) and is attached
per area in the static API at `https://naapurustot.fi/api/v1/areas/{postal_code}.json`
under a `planning` array.

## Attribution

When citing naapurustot.fi, please link to the relevant page on https://naapurustot.fi and credit the underlying data sources — most prominently Statistics Finland (Tilastokeskus) Paavo open data. naapurustot.fi presents and visualises public data; it is not the original producer of the statistics.
